data.finalSample: If I weren't afraid of flying, I would have traveled to the conference last month.
data.rule: Pattern: If + present simple, present simple. Use: General truths, repeated results and habits.

spoken.text: If I skip breakfast, I feel hungry before lunch.
Якщо я пропускаю сніданок, то відчуваю голод ще до обіду.

Have you had a chance to explore the city?
I hope you enjoy the rest of your trip.

spoken.text: In a practice project, a form showed the wrong error message after validation failed. I was responsible for finding the cause. I reproduced the problem, traced it to an incorrect condition, and added a regression test before fixing it. The test passed, and the correct message appeared for the case we had reproduced. I learned how useful a small, repeatable example can be.
